title: 七条常用等值式的批量验证
expected_output:
law                                        holds?
------------------------------------------+-------
p->q == ~p v q                             yes
~(p^q) == ~p v ~q   (De Morgan)            yes
~(p v q) == ~p ^ ~q (De Morgan)            yes
p<->q == (p->q)^(q->p)                     yes
p v (p^q) == p       (absorption)          yes
~~p == p             (double negation)     yes
p^(q v r) == (p^q)v(p^r) (distributive)    yes

7/7 laws verified over all 8 assignments.
tip: rewrite -> and <-> away first, then only ~ ^ v remain.
